material: Buddy Talks AUDIO FILE - the weak and & of
lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll practice two words that native speakers cut down to a single sound. They are... …AND and OF! They shrink and lean on the word before: a lot of

These two are among the most frequent words, so they shape your rhythm. Pronouncing them fully gives every phrase the same weight, and nothing stands out.
